name.en: Annihilator of Desolation Mistral: Mother of Deception

zh.name: 无望冽风的幻灭者•虚妄之母
zh.desc: 受「星核」漫溢的裂界能量同化之后，大守护者幻化为操控虚数能量的歌者，亦是祂所承诺的「新世界」的代言人。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体造成冰属性伤害。
锁定我方单体，下次行动对该目标施放【裂魂寒流】。
对指定我方单体造成大量冰属性伤害，并大概率使受到攻击的我方目标陷入冻结状态。
召唤【无尽寒冬之槊】。
转化为虚数属性，自身速度及造成的伤害提高。
对指定我方单体造成虚数属性伤害，并大概率使受到攻击的我方目标陷入禁锢状态。
进入蓄力状态，下次行动对我方全体施放【创世绝响】。
对我方全体造成大量虚数属性伤害。
每有1个我方目标陷入冻结或禁锢状态，自身及召唤物造成的伤害提高。
无望冽风的幻灭者•虚妄之母受到的伤害大幅降低，但在被弱点击破后，行动额外延后，受到的伤害额外提高，同时使我方全体恢复战技点并激活终结技。
无望冽风的幻灭者•虚妄之母会将自身弱点属性<u>转移</u>给【无尽寒冬之槊】。

70000304.name: 转移
70000304.desc: 将弱点属性转移给目标，弱点属性会在目标被消灭后返回，并造成额外韧性值削减。

skill_list.skill_desc: 无望冽风的幻灭者•虚妄之母施放【裂魂寒流】和【创世和弦】时，会对【无尽寒冬之槊】锁定的目标<u>追加施放</u>。

70000302.name: 追加施放
70000302.desc: 在施放单攻技能后，会重新选择目标并再次使用该技能。

en.name: Annihilator of Desolation Mistral: Mother of Deception
en.desc: After being assimilated by the overflowing Fragmentum energy of the Stellaron, the Supreme Guardian transforms into a chantress able to control Imaginary Energy and the mouthpiece of the Stellaron's promised "new world."

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Ice DMG to a single target.
Locks Onto a single target. The next action uses "Soulrend Coldstream."
Deals massive Ice DMG to a single target, with a high chance to Freeze the attacked target.
Summons "Lance of the Eternal Freeze".
Converts to Imaginary DMG. Increases this unit's SPD and the DMG dealt.
Deals Imaginary DMG to a single target, with a high chance of causing Imprisonment.
Enters the Charging state. The next action uses "Last Choir of Genesis" on all targets.
Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets.
This unit and all its summoned objects gain increased DMG for each Frozen or Imprisoned target on the opposing team.

Damage received by Annihilator of Desolation Mistral: Mother of Deception is greatly reduced. However, after being Weakness Broken, its action is additionally delayed, and it receives more DMG, as well as recovering allies' Skill Points and activating all allies' Ultimates.
The Annihilator of Desolation Mistral: Mother of Deception's will <u>transfer</u> their Weakness Type to Lance of the Eternal Freeze.

70000304.name: Transfer
70000304.desc: Transfers the Weakness Type to the target. The Weakness Type returns to this unit after the target is defeated, and additionally reduces Toughness.

skill_list.skill_desc: When Annihilator of Desolation Mistral: Mother of Deception uses Soulrend Coldstream or Genesis Chord, these abilities will be <u>unleashed additional times</u> against targets locked on by Lance of the Eternal Freeze.

70000302.name: Follow-Up Usage
70000302.desc: After using a single-target ability, re-selects the target and uses the ability again.
